name: Phoenix Nirvana Rebirth 2
detailed_description:
This is the sequel to "Phoenix Nirvana Rebirth":

This is a visual interactive novel that takes readers into a world full of emotional entanglements, intricate interpersonal relationships and hidden conspiracies. The story is set in a contemporary metropolis where power and wealth are intertwined, love and betrayal coexist, and tells the story of Su Wan, the youngest daughter of the declining first family, Su family, who is looking for her own survival position in the midst of crises.

Su Wan met the first evil young man Bo Jingxing, a beautiful man with a cold appearance and countless secrets, and she accidentally became pregnant with his child. As the story unfolds, they are involved in one storm after another, and behind each storm there are bigger secrets.

This game adopts a unique visual interactive mode, which enhances the narrative effect through exquisite illustrations and video scene design, while allowing players to influence the plot according to their own choices. Each decision may change the fate of the character, or even the ending of the whole story, bringing players a deeper sense of immersion.

All in all, “Phoenix Nirvana Rebirth 2” invites you to explore a story of passion, intrigue and rebirth, where your choices will shape the fate of the characters and uncover the truth beneath the surface. Join us on this unforgettable adventure, where every page contains new possibilities and every choice will lead you to a different path.

(Note: This game is the second chapter of the novel, which ends with Bo Jingxing teaching a lesson to those who want to make things difficult for Su Wan at the auction.)

short_description: In order to further deal with the capricious and domineering First Evil Young Master, the daughter of the former richest man who has regained her sight has to continue pretending to be blind in order to gradually uncover the truth about the downfall of her family.
supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English, French, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese*, Korean
*languages with full audio support
